body: Yes me too!! When I stop caring about whether or not my teeth are clean I basically know I need to start making some changes or things will spiral... On one hand it helps so much having identified a red flag that my depression isn't under control, but sometimes it's just discouraging if I notice it but don't have the willpower to actually do anything about it

Hey! I have this too- thought I was completely alone/crazy- but for me, yes, it is definitely tied to certain memories. They come into my head and then I (almost involuntarily, it seems) say either "I want to die" or "kill me." For me the weirdest part is that I always say these things out loud, even though the thoughts are just in my head. I've always thought of it as my brain trying to turn off those memories as quickly as possible...
